serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: So, Do you have any ideas how to repair him?
'Nun' Shanice: Not yet. {{wi}}I may be an expert in this subject, but only few people in the world actually know the code of this AI and even less understand it.
You: There is nothing we can do then, right?
'Nun' Shanice: Well…
You: If so, how about we go somewhere and… 
'Nun' Shanice: There is ONE thing we could try. 
Fuck…
You: What’s the plan? 
'Nun' Shanice: It’s actually pretty easy. We just need to acquire source code of the Priestbots. 
You: That’s all?
'Nun' Shanice: It would be just the beginning of our work. {{wi}}Well, actually my work, because you are not a programmer.
You: You’re right…
'Nun' Shanice: I will try to explain to you the gist of it. 
'Nun' Shanice: His update thing is kinda suspicious and it’s probably its fault he crashed. Sadly we can’t just simply roll back to his previous version. We have no access to his system.
'Nun' Shanice: John Paul put really tricky anti-malware measures into bots, but the biggest obstacle potential hacking would have to overcome is that AI would try to reprogram itself to fight it.
'Nun' Shanice: Sadly, in this situation it’s actually working against us. Anything I try to do right now will be automatically shut off.
'Nun' Shanice: If we can get the source code I will try to reverse engineer his whole software structure. This will help me to create a program that will restart his self defence scripts. 
'Nun' Shanice: You dig? 
You: Uhm, you need a source code and then you will do some IT wizardry. Got it.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceNormal
'Nun' Shanice: Exactly. 
#Nun.Face.nunFaceSerious
You: How do we get the source code?
'Nun' Shanice: I have no idea. We can’t really mail the Vatican and ask them for it.
You: Ok, but who besides the Church has the source code?
#Nun.Face.nunFaceThinking
'Nun' Shanice: Uhm, the Chinese? They ‘allegedly’ made a lot of stuff using it, so it’s not that rare{{wi}} in China. 
'Nun' Shanice: The problem is possessing any of their products that were imported here is illegal in the US. 99% of bots they have sent here were sexbots.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceSerious
You: Sexbots? Why?
'Nun' Shanice: Our government said they wanted to drop the birth rate to unparalleled levels and through that become the number one economy in the world. I don’t know if it’s true or just some propaganda.
Huh? Could my sexbot be a way to repair Priestbot? There is no way such a coincidence could happen.
You: So we must find any other similar and working bot? 
'Nun' Shanice: Pretty much, is what I would want to say, but I don’t really know what was done when Chinese put their hands on this technology. They could downgrade it, or upgrade it or don’t even use it at all! What is important is for the self defence script to be there. 
'Nun' Shanice: The good thing is we don’t really need to destroy the malware by ourselves. We just need to boot up Priestbot’s self defence and it should go smoothly from there.
You: Ok, but how exactly are we supposed to check if there is good code?
'Nun' Shanice: I don’t really know, but I’m sure I would be able to confirm it if I get my hands on it.
What now? I can’t really say that I have my sexbot in my room! She could rat me out any moment! 
I need to probe into this matter a little more, so I can help out and not endanger myself.
You: Let’s say, hypothetically, that we know the location of some sexbot, do you need access to the whole bot, or can we just copy it all on some CD?
#Nun.Face.nunFaceHappy
'Nun' Shanice: CD? Nobody uses those anymore. Nonetheless, their capacity would be too small and you can’t just plug into its main usb slot and then drag and drop it. 
#Nun.Face.nunFaceSerious
You: How would you do it then?
'Nun' Shanice: I would need to open it up and search for a special connection used for debugging purposes. Then I would get the important part out to my external drive. 
You: Uhm, is it safe for the bot?
'Nun' Shanice: I think so? 
#Nun.Face.nunFaceThinking
'Nun' Shanice: You ask a lot of questions about this matter, I wonder why...
Oh no… {{wi}}Did she realize something?!
You: A-{{wi}}ah, w-{{wi}}well, I just want to help {{wi}}or something{{wi}}, hehe... {{wi}}he.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceSerious
'Nun' Shanice: …
#Nun.Face.nunFaceHappy
'Nun' Shanice: I’m happy to hear that! 
#Nun.Face.nunFaceNormal
'Nun' Shanice: Do you have any more questions about it?
Uff.
Thank God she is a silly head. 
You: Uhm, is there a way for me to do it by myself? I mean, getting the important ‘stuff’?
#Nun.Face.nunFaceSerious
'Nun' Shanice: I don’t think so. You are not an expert in this field. I would need to do this personally.
Fuck.
But man, this is a serious matter. Should I risk and help them or just get the fuck out of here and forget everything?
